summary: Inovo is a seed-stage fund focused on founders from Central and Eastern Europe and its diaspora. Its homepage states a first ticket of €500,000 to €4,000,000 with follow-ons up to €10,000,000, a pre-seed and seed stage with mainly seed investments, a multi-vertical industry view, and a geography covering CEE countries from Poland to Albania plus founders from the region building anywhere. Founders reach the team through a linked form. A street address is not stated.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage links a portfolio page and Medium posts on CEE seed and Series A rounds; individual investment dates are not stated on the homepage.

sources.title: Homepage: ticket size, stage, CEE geography, industry view and contact form
